title: BART’s claims presentation said 6%. The audit found about 0.9%.

beats.text: BART approved a claims administrator contract with a ceiling of $14,714,189.

visual.sub: The Board chose a new claims administration contract

beats.text: Five directors voted yes. Two voted no. One abstained.
Two months later, the Board saw 116 referrals for investigation.

visual.label: The 2024 oversight slide put two different referral measures together

beats.text: The slide labeled this 6% of open claims.

visual.kicker: The 2024 oversight slide put two different referral measures together

beats.text: The inspector checked the underlying data and put the rate at about 0.9%.
It also found the state had set no 1% target.
In another claim, a worker disclosed earnings from a second job.

visual.kicker: The inspector recalculated the rate and traced a separate $42,000 error

beats.text: The administrator missed those wages and overpaid about $42,000.

visual.label: The inspector recalculated the rate and traced a separate $42,000 error

beats.text: That overpayment was factored into a settlement.
On November 23, all eight audit recommendations remained in progress.

visual.kicker: All eight recommendations remained open in November
